ACTION=A2
Rationale: The lead vehicle is directly ahead at $x=25.0\text{ m}$ traveling at a much slower speed ($4.2\text{ m/s}$) compared to the ego vehicle's initial speed of $50\text{ kph}$ ($\approx 13.9\text{ m/s}$). To avoid a rear-end collision, the ego vehicle needs to decelerate. Action A2 corresponds to braking/deceleration.
